# Foundgine

Foundgine is a small, provider-independent semantic execution engine for .NET.

Canonical description:
"Foundgine turns structured application intent into a safe, executable, provider-independent plan."

## Architecture

Input adapter → Semantic Request → Resolution → Authorization → Planning → Provider → Data

## Projects

- Foundgine.Abstractions — stable contracts and IDs
- Foundgine.Metadata — domain/storage metadata
- Foundgine.Semantics — semantic model, resolution, granular authorization, and capability discovery
- Foundgine.Planning — provider-independent planning
- Foundgine.Execution — execution and result materialization
- Foundgine.Sql — SQL provider
- Foundgine.Aot / Foundgine.Aot.Generator — compile-time metadata
- Foundgine.Intent.Json — JSON intent adapter
- Foundgine.GraphQL.HotChocolate* — GraphQL adapters

## Current proof

Semantic resolution, granular authorization, capability discovery, query/mutation planning, SQL/SQLite execution, AOT metadata, JSON intent, and Hot Chocolate GraphQL are covered by tests.

## Boundaries

GraphQL and SQL are adapters/providers. They must not leak into the semantic core.

Archive material is historical and is not part of the active runtime.
